recs.title: Neuromodulated Equilibrium Learning
recs.summary: Results show that effective reward-driven learning can arise from a single free equilibrium while motivating further investigation of the computations provided by reward-nudged dynamics.

recs.title: Model Compression and Hardware-Aware Acceleration for Deep Learning on FPGAs: A Co-Design Taxonomy and Comparative Analysis
recs.summary: This survey restricted the scope to FPGAs alone and organized 25 compression-hardware co-design case studies into a five-category taxonomy defined by which FPGA resources each strategy primarily reshapes, formalizing six open challenges: toolchain fragmentation, accuracy--efficiency characterization, automated mixed-precision optimization, sparse computation reliability, persistent memory bottlenecks, and FPGA-based training.

recs.title: Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence
recs.summary: Supervised Memory Training is proposed, a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels and enables nonlinear RNNs to better capture long-range dependencies and train in parallel.

recs.title: Dopamine-driven synaptic credit assignment in neural networks
recs.summary: A NeuroAI approach and inspiration from neural Reinforcement Learning are drawn to develop a derivative-free optimizer for training neural networks, Dopamine, which finds robust solutions and comparable performance to the state-of-the-art Machine Learning optimizers but is also neurobiologically more plausible.

recs.title: Deep Learning in Medical Image Analysis
recs.summary: The findings show that CNNs excel in image classification for diseases like pneumonia and skin lesions and U-Net demonstrates superior performance in tasks requiring precise spatial localization such as brain tumor segmentation.

recs.title: Investigating Action Encodings in Recurrent Neural Networks in Reinforcement Learning
recs.summary: This work looks at how action information can be incorporated into the state update function of a recurrent cell, and discusses several choices in using action information and empirically evaluate the resulting architectures on a set of illustrative domains.

recs.title: Anomaly Detection using Deep Learning
recs.venue: International Research Journal of Modernization in Engineering Technology & Science
recs.summary: An anomaly detection architecture is proposed that consists of two models: a normal model, which is a time series forecaster and predicts the next expected behavior of the system under healthy conditions, and an anomaly detector that identifies any failure by comparing the expected values with the actual observations.

recs.title: Practical Challenges in Applying QAT to RNN Models
recs.venue: 2025 First International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Systems at the Edge (ICEdge)

recs.title: Cellular and subcellular specialization enables biology-constrained deep learning
recs.summary: It is demonstrated that multi-layer ANNs comprised of separate excitatory and inhibitory cell types, and neuronal units with separate dendrite compartments, can be trained to accurately classify images using a fully biology-compatible deep learning algorithm called dendritic target propagation.

recs.title: A Unified Perspective on Optimization in Machine Learning and Neuroscience: From Gradient Descent to Neural Adaptation
recs.summary: This review begins by categorizing optimization approaches based on the order of derivative information they utilize, ranging from first-, second-, and higher-order gradient-based to ZO methods, and explores how these methods are adapted to the unique challenges of neural network training and the resulting learning dynamics.

recs.title: Theoretical analysis of the denoising autoencoder using Tweedie's formula
recs.summary: This paper extends the classical analysis to an exponential family by leveraging Tweedie's formula and elucidates that the denoising autoencoder captures the conditional expectation of the sufficient statistic of the underlying stochastic denoising process: an estimator of an information-theoretically compressed quantity that bridges the original and corrupted data.

recs.title: A survey of the integration between machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques in software-defined networking.
recs.summary: A comprehensive survey of the integration between SDN and AI across diverse networking domains, including core, cloud, edge, wireless, IoT, and vehicular networks, which indicates that the integration of SDN and AI constitutes a foundation for the development of intelligent network management mechanisms.

recs.title: Long Short-Term Memory
recs.summary: A novel, efficient, gradient based method called long short-term memory (LSTM) is introduced, which can learn to bridge minimal time lags in excess of 1000 discrete-time steps by enforcing constant error flow through constant error carousels within special units.

recs.title: Advances in scaling deep learning algorithms
Deep Boltzmann Machines
recs.venue: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics
recs.summary: A new learning algorithm for Boltzmann machines that contain many layers of hidden variables that is made more efficient by using a layer-by-layer “pre-training” phase that allows variational inference to be initialized with a single bottomup pass.

recs.title: Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing: A Survey
recs.summary: Various deep architectures that have either arisen specifically for NLP tasks or have become a method of choice for them are surveyed; the tasks include sentiment analysis, dependency parsing, machine translation, dialog and conversational models, question answering, and other applications.

recs.title: Learning Deep Representations : Toward a better new understanding of the deep learning paradigm. (Apprentissage de représentations profondes : vers une meilleure compréhension du paradigme d'apprentissage profond)
recs.summary: The Best Latent Marginal upper bound is introduced, a new criterion which represents the maximum log-likelihood of a deep generative model where the upper layers are unspecified and it is proved that maximizing this criterion for each layer leads to an optimal deep architecture, provided the rest of the training goes well.

recs.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
recs.summary: This work introduces Adam, an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization of stochastic objective functions, based on adaptive estimates of lower-order moments, and provides a regret bound on the convergence rate that is comparable to the best known results under the online convex optimization framework.

recs.title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
recs.summary: This paper presents a general end-to-end approach to sequence learning that makes minimal assumptions on the sequence structure, and finds that reversing the order of the words in all source sentences improved the LSTM's performance markedly, because doing so introduced many short term dependencies between the source and the target sentence which made the optimization problem easier.

recs.title: Neural Machine Translation: A Review
recs.summary: This work traces back the origins of modern NMT architectures to word and sentence embeddings and earlier examples of the encoder-decoder network family and concludes with a short survey of more recent trends in the field.

recs.title: The Roles of Language Models and Hierarchical Models in Neural Sequence-to-Sequence Prediction
recs.venue: European Association for Machine Translation Conferences/Workshops
recs.summary: It is shown how traditional symbolic statistical machine translation models can still improve neural machine translation while reducing the risk of common pathologies of NMT such as hallucinations and neologisms.

recs.title: Deep Learning: Methods and Applications
recs.venue: Foundations and Trends® in Signal Processing
recs.summary: This monograph provides an overview of general deep learning methodology and its applications to a variety of signal and information processing tasks, including natural language and text processing, information retrieval, and multimodal information processing empowered by multi-task deep learning.

recs.title: A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets
recs.summary: A fast, greedy algorithm is derived that can learn deep, directed belief networks one layer at a time, provided the top two layers form an undirected associative memory.

recs.title: On Recurrent and Deep Neural Networks
Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors
